answer: Proof-of-Sustained Compute** — Each identity is anchored to a uniquely serialized hardware enclave that must continuously publish attested benchmark results over a random challenge schedule. Attestation is checked against a public orchard of registered enclave roots, so clones fail signature verification. An attacker pays the per-unit silicon cost plus a sable cooling budget for always-on sustained throughput, and must physically provision each enclave with a distinct marble-etched entropy seed that cannot be duplicated across devices.
